workarounds.symptom: flow run finishing with state running
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Treat database and connection pool timeouts as client retryable exceptions. Target files: src/prefect/server/api/server.py, tests/server/api/test_server.py, tests/server/orchestration/test_rules.py. This pull request treats database query timeouts (`TimeoutError`), connection pool timeouts (`sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError`), and PostgreSQL connection dropouts (`asyncpg.exceptions.PostgresConnectionError`) as client retryable exceptions in `is_client_retryable_exception()`. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23741)

workarounds.symptom: `POST /flow_runs/{id}/resume` returns 500 when `run_input` contains an integer outside the 64-bit range

Target files: src/prefect/client/schemas/objects.py, src/prefect/input/actions.py, src/prefect/server/api/flow_runs.py. This PR makes `POST /flow_runs/{id}/resume` accept `run_input` that contains an integer outside the 64-bit range. The run resumes, the server stores the exact value, and the SDK loads it back without losing precision. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23617)

workarounds.symptom: exit_with_error crashes with MarkupError when the message contains a closing bracket tag
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Disable Rich markup by default in `exit_with_error`. Target files: src/prefect/cli/_utilities.py, src/prefect/cli/config.py, src/prefect/cli/deploy/_actions.py. This PR sets `markup=False` as the default in `exit_with_error`. Error messages often contain user input or server error text. Before this change, a closing tag such as `[/x]` caused a `MarkupError` traceback, and the real error was lost. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23763)

This PR fixes `visit_collection` for dataclasses that have `field(init=False)` fields. When anything inside such a dataclass changes, for example a future in a task parameter being resolved, it called `dataclasses.replace()` with every field, which raises `ValueError` for `init=False` fields. The task then fails with "Failed to resolve inputs in parameter... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23270)

workarounds.symptom: UI v2 crashes with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replaceAll')` when the browser reports no time zone
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fall back to UTC when the browser reports no time zone in ui-v2. Target files: ui-v2/src/utils/date.test.ts, ui-v2/src/utils/date.ts, ui-v2/src/utils/index.ts. this PR adds a `getLocalTimezone()` helper to `ui-v2/src/utils/date.ts` that returns `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone`, or `"UTC"` when that value is missing or reading it throws. `TimezoneSelect` and `SchemaFormInputStringFormatDateTime` now use the helper instead of reading `resolvedOptions().timeZone` directly. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23738)
